verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents session recordings for debugging failures: rrweb DOM/interaction replays and MP4 video (docs-7, docs-14). Live viewing of agent runs is also documented (docs-11). Screenshots appear only as scrape output formats, not as per-step run artifacts, and no step-by-step agent action timeline is evidenced. Missing for 10: step-by-step action timelines for agent runs, per-step screenshots captured during runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of replay debugging.
